fields.label: Who this is
fields.hint: One or two lines about the person behind the face. It is what stops a portrait being a mannequin.
fields.placeholder: A ferry engineer of twenty years who would rather be fixing something than talking.

fields.label: How they present
fields.hint: Male, female, non binary, or however they would put it themselves. Left empty, it is decided from everything else.
fields.placeholder: Non binary, and comfortable being read either way.

fields.label: Signature object, in detail
fields.hint: If the object in their possession matters, describe it here and it will be drawn with care.
fields.placeholder: A brass pocket compass, the glass crazed, worn smooth on one side.

fields.label: Your own additions
fields.hint: Anything else this particular image needs.
fields.placeholder: Caught mid laugh at something off to the left.

fields.label: Things to keep out
fields.hint: Use sparingly. Naming a thing puts the word in the prompt either way. Three items maximum.
